observed: Two same-seeded equality-coupled graphs produce identical1000draws after changing only later weights1:1-to1:9 in both editions.
initial_concern: Read in isolation,2017 monotonic-weighting language appeared to conflict with first-binding priority.
correction: Full2017 clause18.5.4 and2023 clause18.5.3 permit satisfying hard constraints when requested statistical distributions conflict. Equality-coupled1:1 and1:9 marginals cannot both be satisfied. The measured priority alone therefore does not prove a conformance defect.

primary_interpretive_source.scope: Committee-author explanation of equality-coupled conflicting distributions; corroboration only, current IEEE editions remain normative.
primary_interpretive_source.summary: Different solver priorities are permitted for conflicting distributions; hard domains and zero-weight exclusions still apply.

policy: Retain documented Icarus stable ordering for conflicting weight requests; do not invent a mandated product rule or claim an industry-identical joint distribution. Single distribution ratios, hard domains, zero-weight exclusions and explicit solve-before obligations remain enforced.
implementation_status: No source changes for this interpretation review.
